subject: Steward match, acceptance matrix, and kickoff confirmation
body:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Adele Torres <adele.torres@novahealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Sales → CS: steward match proposal & acceptance matrix

Hi Adele — thanks again for the time yesterday. A quick thread to capture the handoff details and propose next steps so we can get the implementation schedule locked in.

Deal snapshot (short):
- Account: NovaHealth (enterprise, multi-region)
- Logo / ARR: mid-six-figure initial commit (see HubSpot)
- Target go-live: 2026-12-15 (customer target)
- Key constraints: VPC deployment, data residency in US, SSO via SAML, HC/IT approval required for network egress

Attachments (first pass): SOW_v1.docx, Acceptance_Matrix_v3.xlsx, Implementation_Risk_Log.pdf — all attached below.

Immediate asks for handoff:
1) Confirm technical contacts & availability for a 60–90 minute pre-kickoff tech deep-dive the week of 11/22.
2) Confirm acceptance criteria in the attached matrix — we’ve set a 2-stage acceptance (pilot -> full go-live).
3) Approve proposed CS steward: Monica Patel (CS Lead) to be introduced as the primary post-sale owner.

Proposed internal owners (quick):
- CS lead: Monica Patel (owner for onboarding, staffing, post-launch SLA)
- Implementation SME: Ben Carter (integration leads, infra runbook)
- Account lead: Tessa Morgan (exec sponsor, billing/contract liaison)
- Escalation: Karthik Iyer (Director, Post-Sales)

Adele — if you can reply with your preferred time window and list of any additional stakeholders (IT/legal procurement), we’ll get Monica looped and share a draft kickoff agenda.

Cheers,
Tessa Morgan
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference

Thanks Tessa — this looks good and I appreciate the clarity. Michael Cruz (IT lead) will be the technical point for network and SSO — I’m copying him here.

We can do a pre-kickoff tech call the week of 11/22; our preference is 11/23 or 11/24 mornings PT.

A couple notes from procurement/IT:
- We will need to review SOC 2 evidence and a data processing addendum before we start provisioning.
- For the pilot, we prefer to run in a dedicated VPC in us-west-2; can you confirm if Redwood Dedicated is required or if a hosted VPC option covers our isolation needs?

I’ll confirm the rest of the attendees after Michael checks availability. Looking forward to the intro to Monica.

Best,

Subject: Re: Sales → CS: steward match proposal & acceptance matrix

Internal note — quick proposed plan from implementation POV:

1) Steward assignment: recommend Monica Patel as CS Lead. Monica has recent Dedicated deployments and is familiar with VPC kickstarts. She’ll own the onboarding SOW and weekly status.

2) High-level timeline (4 weeks):
- Week 0 (pre-kickoff): tech checklist, SSO metadata exchange, network whitelist, access to test dataset
- Week 1–2: pilot configuration, basic ingestion, validation with acceptance matrix v1/v2
- Week 3: pilot stabilization, runbook handover, acceptance runbook rehearsals
- Week 4: final acceptance & go/no-go for full rollout

3) Risks:
- If customer requires a Dedicated-only setup, procurement for capacity may add 2–3 weeks to timeline.
- SSO metadata delays (common) — recommend we lock SAML details at pre-kickoff.
- Customer security asks may require an expanded SOC/pen test cadence — have SOC artifacts in hand and an escalation channel to security.

Action items for this thread:
- Tessa: confirm procurement timeline & whether NovaHealth has any unique legal clauses (procurement).
- Karthik: confirm escalation SLA and whether we need security to join the pre-kickoff.
- Marissa: draft the kickoff agenda and calendar invite once Adele confirms date.

Ben
Ben Carter
Implementation Manager | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

-----Forwarded message-----
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Sales → CS: steward match proposal & acceptance matrix

Adele / Michael — looping in Monica Patel who will be your CS Lead for NovaHealth. Monica — welcome; high-level commitments below and a couple of next steps.

Commitments (Redwood):
- Monica (CS Lead) will own onboarding, run weekly status, and be the primary for all implementation deliverables.
- Ben (Implementation SME) will drive infra and networking tasks, coordinate test environment builds, and support the pilot validation.
- Tessa will remain as the account sponsor and handle billing/contract follow-ups.

Next steps for kickoff week (11/22 window):
1) Pre-kickoff tech check (30–60 mins) — confirm SAML metadata, VPC subnet/wire rules, temporary test credentials. (Owner: Ben)
2) Kickoff (60–90 mins on 11/23 10:00 AM PT) — agenda: intros, scope review, acceptance matrix walkthrough, pilot success criteria, timeline (Owner: Monica + Tessa)
3) Share draft runbook & acceptance matrix (see attached Acceptance_Matrix_v3.xlsx) — customer to mark any edits by 11/20.
4) DocuSign: SOW_v1.docx will be routed for signature after acceptance items are agreed.

Adele — can you confirm 11/23 10:00 AM PT for the kickoff? Michael — can you confirm your team can make the pre-kickoff tech check on 11/22 (we can do 11/22 9:00 AM PT)?

Thanks all — Monica will follow up with calendar invites and a short kickoff pack.

Best,
